channel.title: Joe — Vendor Security Advisories
channel.description: Security advisories and PSIRTs from network and infrastructure vendors in use.

item.title: 🟠 Arbitrary process termination from exposed minifilter communication port
item.description:
Why this matters: Infrastructure/vendor signal — compare your installed versions and support status.

CVSSv3 Score: 4.7

An Unverified Ownership Vulnerability [CWE-283] in FortiClient Windows fortimon3 driver may allow an authenticated attacker to terminate arbitrary processes via an exposed minifilter communication port.

Revised on 2026-09-08 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 13h

item.title: 🟠 Broken Access control on Websocket streams
item.description:
Why this matters: Infrastructure/vendor signal — compare your installed versions and support status.

CVSSv3 Score: 4.9

item.title: 🟠 Improper Authentication of FortiPAM Server
